text:
deploy-bot: starting migration deploy: migration/2026-03-20-add-tenant-id.sql to prod in 5m. Canary plan: 1% for 10m -> 10% for 10m. Holdpoint: 10m post-canary. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/migrations#add-tenant-id. Rollback: revert PR #1234.
alex: heads up, this touches user_profiles index and the write path. please pin api service to v3.12.1 before we cut.
maria: pinning now. @deploy-bot set service_pin=v3.12.1
deploy-bot: service pin applied by maria.
jay: saw a 2x latency bump in staging when the backfill ran yesterday, small sample though. want to watch tail latency closely.
sam-sre: replication lag on prod replicas is 15s right now (`replica_lag_seconds`). we should not start a backfill while lag > 5s. recommend pausing if lag stays high at canary time.
maria: can we reduce the initial canary to 0.5% and extend the watch window to 20m? that should give us more signal without big exposure.
alex: fine with 0.5% + 20m watch. if lag or error-rate spikes, we abort. Rollback criteria: >=0.5% 5xx or queue depth up 30% sustained for 5m -> revert.
tess: quick note about backfill idempotency: the script marks rows with `tenant_migrated = true` and uses UPSERT semantics, so resume should be safe. db-admin can confirm.
db-admin: confirmed, backfill uses idempotent UPSERT and a migration marker table. resume is safe; we can also run `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE tenant_id IS NULL;` to estimate remaining.
maria: ok changing plan: canary=0.5% -> watch 20m -> escalate to 5% if stable. holdpoint at 20m.
sam-sre: i'll watch replica lag and trigger manual pause if >8s at any time during canary.
alex: also note release notes and support: add note to changelog about tenant id nullable->not-null change and rollback steps.
maria: added to release notes and pinged support channel.
jay: if we need to pause mid-canary, what's the quick command?
tess: run `deployctl pause migration/2026-03-20-add-tenant-id.sql --reason "holdpoint"` or in UI hit the pause button.
alex: decision: start canary at 0.5% in 3m. watch 20m. if any of the rollback criteria hit, perform revert PR #1234 and run backfill in off-peak.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary 0.5% initiated.
maria: ack, monitoring metrics.
sam-sre: replica lag at start = 4s. good to go for now.
jay: i'm observing a small 95th pct tail increase in tokenization service, ~120ms -> ~160ms, keeping an eye.
alex: if tail doesn't settle in 10m we pause.
maria: pause issued manually at 3512350200 because tail latency still trending up and a minor spike in DB errors.
deploy-bot: deploy paused by maria at 3512350200. reason: observed tail latency + db error spike.
tess: thanks — i'll prepare rollback checklist and validate rollback job is green in ci.
db-admin: prepping to run the revert and backfill plan if needed. will check replicas and stall any ongoing backfill jobs.
sam-sre: i'll coordinate read-replica catch-up and verify no replication slot bloat.
alex: fine — we'll hold here. if metrics recover in next 30m we can reassess; otherwise we trigger rollback. i'll be oncall for rollback.
maria: ack. will post follow-up in 10m with metrics snapshot. :hourglass: 
deploy-bot: deploy remains paused. awaiting manual resume or rollback.
